texts.preamble: P.Rajagopalan Nair vs Thiruvananthapuram Corporation on 11 October, 2018 Author: Hrishikesh Roy Bench: Hrishikesh Roy, A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable The Chief Justice Mr.Hrishikesh Roy & The Honourable Mr. Justice A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar. Thursday, The 11Th Day Of October 2018 / 19Th Aswina, 1940 WA.No. 1878 of 2018 Against The Judgment In Wp(C) 17458/2018 of High Court Of Kerala Dated 31.8.2018 Appellant/Appellant: P.Rajagopalan Nair Aged 77 Years, Former Cmd, Kerala Sidco, Madhaviswaram(G-3), Vellayambalam, Trivandrum-695 010. By Advs.Sri.P.Sanjay Smt.A.Parvathi Menon Respondents/Respondents: 1 Thiruvananthapuram Corporation, Corporation Buildings, Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram, Represened By Its Secretary, Pin-695 001. 2 The Commissioner Of Police, Thiruvananthapuram, Pin - 695 014. WA.No. 1878 of 2018 2 5 The Sub Inspector Of Police, Museum Thiruvananthapuram, Pin - 695 033. 6 The Health Officer, Thiruvananthapuram Corporation, Corporation Buildings, Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram Pin - 695 033. 7 Abbas, Irani Fast Food, Near Bus Stop And Oxygen Outlet, Vellayambalam, Trivandrum - 695 010. R1 & R6 By Sri.N.Nandakumara Menon (Sr.) Sc,Tvpm Corp Sri.P.K.Manojkumar, Sc, Tvpm Corporation R2 To R5 By Sr.Govt.Pleader Sri.Aravindakumar Babu R7 By Adv.Smt.S.S.Sailakshmi By Adv.M.Sreekumar Sri.K.P.Jayachandran This Writ Appeal Having Come Up For Admission On 11.10.2018, The Court On The Same Day Passed The Following: WA.No. 1878 of 2018 3 Judgment
texts.facts: It is also her submission that the 7th respondent has applied for a licence to the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation but the same is yet to be considered.
texts.arguments: According to the learned counsel, the 7th respondent is having a licence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the observation to the contrary in the judgment as well as in this Court's order on 9.10.2018, is factually incorrect to this extent. 2. In view of the above projection made by the 7 th respondent, the learned counsel for the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation submits that the application for licence would be considered in accordance with law and since the ' thattukada' was operating just opposite the appellant's residence, the appellant/writ petitioner would also be heard. P.Rajagopalan Nair vs Thiruvananthapuram Corporation on 11 October, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24936999/ 2 3.
